parsed.explanation: No trans-specific criminal offence, facility ban, or documented trans-targeted enforcement, so no tier-1 universal exposure is documented. But the surrounding record is bleak: a public-morals provision penalising public same-sex expression more harshly than other morals offences, used as a lever — the only domestic NGO records arrests on false accusations of same-sex intercourse plus mistreatment and torture of LGBTQ people by police, with no anti-discrimination law, no hate-crime recourse, no legal gender recognition, and no known advocacy organisations. Extrajudicial killing and torture at state hands with impunity is the only available context should a visitor be detained. Societal stigma is entrenched, with SOGI framed as an imported threat. No trans-specific incidence data exists; per the thin-data rule I extrapolate from the police-abuse record and total absence of remedy, placing this in the High Risk band just below the 0.35 anchors, which have documented trans-specific exposure this dossier lacks.
